m2-control.title: The negative control: real spine, zero agent-authored records, independent ground truth
m2-control.imperative: Write tests/test_episode_negative_control.py. Drive a real spine through the real engine in a temp work area, issuing ONLY mechanically-required verbs (claim/attest/start/advance/reopen + induced failures) -- no --finding, no narrative attach, no agent-authored text. The harness maintains its OWN expected values, incremented at the moment it issues each triggering call. FORBIDDEN as oracle: mechanical_fields(), the emitted snapshot, reopen_total(), failed_command_count(), context_manifest.rev(). context-manifest-ref expectation is an independently computed git blob OID. Comparison returns a LIST OF MISMATCHED FIELD NAMES, not a boolean. Cover BOTH topologies from m1 and report each honestly; a refused field is asserted as refused-and-expected-to-be-refused with its reason, visibly distinct from an uncollected one.

The discriminating red-proof lives in tests/, not only in .agent-work/. Restore after every mutation and PROVE restoration by blob OID vs HEAD or clean git status.

Mark one cluster consolidated; confirm neighbours() STILL finds its neighbours afterwards. Record neighbours() before and after. Verify the synthetic consolidation is discarded -- temp store AND canon blob OIDs unchanged. Report the #321 observation: was the handed episode id validated?

preconditions.satisfied_by: m3 red-proof complete; both mutations proven and restored.

postconditions.statement: retrieval test passes: neighbours() finds the cluster's neighbours after consolidation, seeded through apply_delta into a temp store

AFTER retiring cluster-002 with consolidated-into=cluster-001: neighbour_ids(root,'cluster-002') == ['cluster-001','cluster-003'] -- UNCHANGED, the surviving-consolidation property holds because the anchor is fetched by id. From the other side: neighbour_ids('cluster-001') == ['cluster-003'] (ordinary set, consolidated member archived) and == ['cluster-002','cluster-003'] with include_retired=True, so 'it vanished' and 'it moved' stay distinguishable. Discrimination proven: outsider-001 has ZERO neighbours, so a full result and an empty result are both observable. #321 OBSERVATION: on the WRITE path a handed id is validated -- create REFUSES a supplied id outright (the writer assigns it) and retire validates its handed id against ID_RE before applying; the unvalidated handed id is on the READ path, where query_episodes.fetch_episode('NOT A VALID ID', root) returns None rather than refusing, so 'no such episode' and 'you handed me nonsense' read identically. Not fixed here.

why_trail.why: Handoff read in full and verified complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions all present). System under test read: episode_capture.mechanical_fields + REQUIRED_MECHANICAL_FIELDS, the seam at checklist_engine start:1663/reopen:1893, refusals armed at claim:964 and incremented only in main()'s EngineError branch:2617 (so refusals only move via the CLI, never the Python API). BEFORE listing of episodes/active/ captured: 3 tracked blobs, store NON-empty.

Handoff's MEASURED FINDING is CONFIRMED, not refuted: the code agrees. Lease-topology dependence is real and structural. The control must therefore drive BOTH topologies and report per-topology; a single claimed standalone spine would be the vacuous shape the handoff warns about.

Control drives a real parent->child gated run through the engine CLI (CLI, not the API, because refusals only moves in main()'s EngineError branch). Only claim/start/attest/advance/reopen issued; attest carries no note and advance uses --mechanical, so no agent-authored prose exists in the run. Independent tally incremented at issue time; the four counters land on 1/2/3/4 so no two can be swapped undetected. Both topologies asserted, refusals asserted as refusals.

The control is proven falsifiable at per-field granularity, not merely by exit code. Four in-suite monkeypatch red-proofs assert exact mismatch lists (all-ten, [failed-commands], [role], [reopens]); the [role] one is the important one because it proves the REFUSAL assertions can themselves go red, which is where a refusal-heavy control would otherwise be vacuous.

Cross-run retrieval demonstrated in a temp store seeded through apply_delta; the synthetic consolidation never touches canon (temp store + an in-suite assertion that episodes/ is clean and non-empty).

g3 complete. Control green on both topologies against an independent per-field oracle; proven red by two restored source mutations and four in-suite per-field red-proofs including one that falsifies the refusal assertions themselves; retrieval survives consolidation in a throwaway store; canon provably untouched by blob OID; suite green with the delta fully accounted.
